iko.text: Drannith is the fortified human city of Ikoria, and after Lukka bonds with a monster he is banned from it and made an outcast. General Kudro enacts stringent security measures at every entry point, and Lukka, whose winged tiger is shot and captured at the city, witnesses its execution and marches his monster army on Drannith.

At a parley Lukka stabs Kudro to death, and Jirina refuses to join him, so she flees to command Drannith's defenses. In the Siege of Drannith monsters breach the inner city, but the bonders charge through the gates to rescue Jirina and turn the tide, while Vivien summons a monstrosaur to distract Lukka.

The Ozolith explodes, severing Lukka from his beasts and igniting his planeswalker spark, and the leaderless monsters scatter, after which Jirina becomes colonel and bonded humans and monsters may live in the First Ring.
